framework.target_question: Can one audited pilot row salvage REJECT into bounded technical progress, or is it still only protocol packaging?
framework.scope_guard: This is a salvage boundary for the CphiPacket evidence class only. It is not a universal no-go claim about all future nickelate work or all future packet designs.
framework.answer: One real audited pilot row is enough only if it is genuinely blind, lineage-audited, and extraction-separated. Without those properties, it is still protocol packaging.
framework.salvage_standard: The row must demonstrate that the packet can exist as an auditable workflow, not that R_oe is already decided.

minimum_real_pilot_conditions: The row is real data from one same-sample or formally sistered specimen lineage, not a literature montage or synthetic mock row.
An immutable raw archive exists before any superconducting-output reveal, with timestamped hashes or equivalent custody evidence.
P_oe and B_min are extracted from separate raw stores or hash-locked scripts, and B_min does not reuse the fitted qz/c-axis/orbital state that defines P_oe.
Canonical P_oe censoring, denominator floor, and U_miss are frozen before reveal and cannot be changed after inspection of output or B_min correlation.
Output labels are sealed, a blind custodian exists, and the green/yellow/red firewall is pre-registered before any row inclusion decision.
Row lineage, calibration, and mismatch tolerances are predeclared so the row can be audited without post-hoc rescue.
The row survives the primary firewall as green or, at minimum, declared yellow under the frozen rules before reveal.
instant_failure_conditions: No immutable raw archive or custody hash exists.
P_oe and B_min share the same fitted extraction state, especially qz/c-axis/orbital state, or B_min is derived from P_oe outputs.
Output labels, row selection, censoring, denominator floor, or U_miss are changed after seeing output or B_min alignment.
The row is rescued, added, dropped, or sistered after output inspection.
The row is not same-sample or formally sistered, and lineage cannot be audited.
Red rows enter the primary residual test.
Blind custody is absent or broken.

can_prove: A blinded, audited workflow is executable on at least one real row.
P_oe and B_min can be kept information-separated in practice for a pilot row.
The firewall, censoring, and custody rules are concrete enough to audit.
The packet is more than abstract protocol packaging if the row is real and passes the frozen audit.
cannot_prove: It cannot establish statistical decision-grade support or refutation.
It cannot prove the whole campaign scales to N=48 or any other target.
It cannot justify a universal no-go for nickelate measurements.
It cannot validate the physical theory claim beyond bounded feasibility.

must_concede_salvage_success_if: At least one audited real pilot row exists.
The audit shows the row passed the frozen firewall before reveal.
The audit shows independent extraction for P_oe and B_min without shared fitted state.
explicit_nonconcession: No concession that R_oe is proven.
No concession that the packet is decision-grade.
No concession that future rows or full campaigns must succeed.

claims.claim: A single audited pilot row can convert REJECT into bounded technical progress if and only if it is real, blind, lineage-audited, and extraction-separated.
Without immutable custody, frozen censoring, and independent extraction, the same row remains protocol packaging.
One audited row can demonstrate feasibility of the packet, but not R_oe itself.
This salvage criterion does not imply any universal no-go for future nickelate experiments.

inspector_check.primary_test: one audited real pilot row is sufficient only for bounded technical progress, not for R_oe adjudication
